def VTask.map {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (M : Matroid α) (f : α → β) (hf : Set.InjOn f M.E) : Matroid β :=
{
  E := f '' M.E,
  Indep := λ s, M.Indep (s.preimage f hf),
  IsBase := λ b, M.IsBase (b.preimage f hf),
  eRk := λ X, M.eRk (X.preimage f hf),
  linspan := λ X, f '' M.linspan (X.preimage f hf),
  bot := by simp [preimage_empty],
  top := by simp [preimage_univ],
  sup_le := λ s t hst, by
    rw [preimage_union] at hst
    exact M.sup_le (hst.1 ▸ M.sup_le hst.2),
  le_sup := λ s t hst, by
    rw [preimage_inter] at hst
    exact M.le_sup (hst.1 ▸ M.le_sup hst.2),
  eq_top_iff := by
    simp only [top, preimage_univ]
    exact M.eq_top_iff,
  eq_bot_iff := by
    simp only [bot, preimage_empty]
    exact M.eq_bot_iff,
  indep_of_indep_preimage := λ s hs, by
    rw [← preimage_image_eq] at hs
    exact M.indep_of_indep hs,
  base_of_base_preimage := λ b hb, by
    rw [← preimage_image_eq] at hb
    exact M.base_of_base hb,
  eRk_of_eRk_preimage := λ X heRk, by
    rw [← preimage_image_eq] at heRk
    exact M.eRk_of_eRk heRk,
  linspan_of_linspan_preimage := λ X hlinspan, by
    rw [← preimage_image_eq] at hlinspan
    exact M.linspan_of_linspan hlinspan,
}
